pricing.details: A Monthly / Yearly toggle with “Yearly - 2 months free” is on the page; both official prices are listed (a usual billing toggle, not a flash promo). Free — 5 € in credits to get started, 1 million words of AI text detection free every month, 20 AI image checks, API key included. Pro 5 €/month or 45 €/year — 9 € in credits included every month, pay-as-you-go credits, monthly rollovers, unlocks all modalities; 2 million words, 500 image checks, 1,000 seconds of video checks. Business 90 €/month or 905 €/year — 90 € in credits every month, 20 million words, 6,600 image checks, 13,300 seconds of video, 25% off image/audio/video checks vs Pro, rollovers, reseller rights up to 4,524 €/month (above that: let’s chat). Enterprise is custom (on-prem, private instances, contact us). Per-unit credits are not displayed in euros.
